nodes.state:
Fictional bank review policy for C-202: the customer requests a total credit
line of 10000 USD, replacing the current 5000 USD line. A 6000 USD total line is an
alternative. Supplied all-in stressed monthly minimum payments at full
utilization are 300 USD for 10000 USD, 180 USD for 6000 USD, and 150 USD for the current
5000 USD. These are illustrative account-term estimates, not a statutory
percentage formula. Each line must leave at least 600 USD per month after living
expenses, other debt payments, and its stressed card payment. The account gate
requires complete records, at least 12 timely payments, and no delinquency,
over-limit balance, or unresolved restriction. Recommend the highest eligible
line up to the request; if no increase qualifies, retain the current line only
if it qualifies; otherwise refer for manual review. Missing evidence also
requires manual review.
